scope: Declared kit graph and report004; not entire repository, portfolio canonical graph, or physical hardware

merkle.canonical: json sort_keys separators compact ensure_ascii false UTF8 allow_nan false

mmr.cfmo_field_adapter: step FCO identity; no claim of CFMO-store execution
mmr.bag: left-to-right fold; SHA256(HYDRALAMP_MMR_BAG_V1: || folded raw peak)
mmr.verification: independent power-of-two partition and all-prefix reconstruction

classification.SELF_SAFE: null until tested; not false merely because unknown
classification.admission: OBSERVED named schema-valid row ADMITTED for custody; FAILED/NEGATIVE REJECTED; remaining QUARANTINED
classification.meaning: custody admission does not establish claim truth or safety

diagnostic.n: max(count of prior+current non-genesis step admissions,1)
diagnostic.tau: 0.35 inherited from source; NOT empirically calibrated here
diagnostic.delta_G_star: current rounded G_star minus previous rounded G_star, round6
diagnostic.ceiling: Unvalidated adapted information-state diagnostic; not physical free energy, safety or accuracy

authorization: Read-only probes + append-only local receipts; no installs, repairs, inference, sponsor calls, funds or publish

successor.sponsor_truth: Only actual observed executions promoted; Akash and Pi pending
